title: 3.2.7 Lab: findRectangleArea (multi-parameter)
description: Define findRectangleArea(width, height) that returns the area, then call it and log the result. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Define findRectangleArea
steps.instructions: Define a function called findRectangleArea that takes two parameters, width and height.

steps.title: Return the area
steps.instructions: Inside the function, hand back the area by returning width multiplied by height. Use return, not console.log, so the caller receives a number.

steps.title: Call it and log the result
steps.instructions: Call findRectangleArea with two numbers, store or pass the result, and use console.log to print it. Try a second call with different numbers.
